overview: Afghanistan is a landlocked country in South and Central Asia. Its capital and largest city is Kabul. For centuries it sat on trade routes linking Persia, India and Central Asia, including the Silk Road. Afghanistan has been through decades of war since the late 1970s, and in 2021 the Taliban took control of the country. Pashto and Dari are its main languages.

geography.text: The Hindu Kush mountains run through the centre and north-east of Afghanistan, where peaks rise above 7,000 metres. The narrow Wakhan Corridor in the far north-east reaches out to a short border with China. The south and west are mostly dry plateaus and desert, and farming depends on rivers fed by melting mountain snow.
